subject: XRHealth - tailored log erasure validation & SIG evidence request
messages:
From: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@xrhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: XRHealth - request for tailored log erasure validation & SIG evidence

Hi Jordan / Neha,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 package you shared last quarter — that was helpful. As part of our SIG/CAIQ closeout for procurement, Legal and InfoSec asked for a bit more concrete evidence around two things: a) the mechanism you use to delete tenant-scoped logs (proof-of-delete workflow + any template cert you can provide), and b) a small sampled manifest showing how you validate erasure for a subset of tenants (for our auditor).

Specifically, our auditor wants:
- an example deletion certificate or attestation template we can reference in our report;
- a 10-sample manifest (anonymized tenant IDs ok) showing timestamps of deletion, TTL policy applied, and who executed the delete;
- a short note on immutability/append-only logs (if any) and whether snapshots or escrow processes are used for forensic preserves;
- confirmation how Redwood handles legal-hold requests (time-to-acknowledge and preservation workflow).

We understand some artifacts are sensitive. If possible, can you provide an export that redacts tenant identifiers but preserves timestamps/fields auditors require? We are hoping to upload the package to our SIG workspace and close this control by end of week.

Thanks — appreciate a rapid turnaround here.

Sara Mendoza
Head of Security & Compliance
XRHealth

Attachments: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@xrhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: XRHealth - request for tailored log erasure validation & SIG evidence

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the clear list. We can provide everything you asked for but want to confirm a few scoping details before packaging:

1) Redaction: we will substitute tenant IDs with hashed identifiers and include a short mapping key (hash-only; no PII). Is that acceptable to your auditor?
2) Sample size: you asked for 10 samples. We normally provide 10 as a default, but we can do 20 if the auditor prefers more statistical confidence.
3) Legal-hold workflow: we will include the runbook excerpt showing SLA for acknowledgement and the preservation handoff (ticketing + snapshot). Note that any escrow snapshots are retained in offline cold storage for 90 days by default but we can highlight extension options for customers requiring longer.

Plan: Jordan to prepare the attestation template and deletion-cert example (PDF), Neha to generate the anonymized log-sample-manifest.csv and scrub tenant identifiers, Stephanie to draft the SIG/CAIQ mapping note and include a short paragraph on immutability/append-only behavior. We will package as a ZIP with readme and upload to your Drive link when ready.

Target: initial package by Thu 23 Jul 2026 18:00 UTC. If that works, we will proceed.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: deletion-cert-template.pdf (stub)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:25:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: XRHealth artifacts - manifest & redaction plan

Jordan / Stephanie — prepping the manifest now. Quick internal notes so we stay audit-friendly:

- I will pull 12 tenant events from the retention-deletion logs (to give a small buffer) and replace tenant_id with sha256(tid + salt) before export. Salt will be recorded in a secure note and not shared.
- For each sample row I'll include: hashed_id, retention_policy (e.g., 30d-sig, 90d-ephemeral), delete_initiator (system/manual), delete_timestamp (ISO), evidence_blob_ref (internal path), and verification_status (true/false).
- For immutability: our serving runtime writes append-only event logs to S3 with object lock disabled by default; we keep short-lived forensic snapshots on WORM-capable buckets only when a legal-hold is opened. I'll add a concise paragraph to the SIG mapping doc.
- Legal-hold SLAs: we ack in 4 business hours and escalate to Legal + Infra if hold extends beyond 72 hours; preservation snapshot creation target is 12 hours.

I'll attach the CSV and manifest to the package and mark fields that are redacted. Jordan — want me to generate both 10- and 20-sample manifests and include both?

Neha
Senior Security Analyst | Redwood Inference

Attachment: log-sample-manifest.csv (draft, anonymized)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@xrhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@xrhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: XRHealth - packaged SIG evidence & sample manifest (deliverable)

Sara / Alex — attaching the package we discussed. Summary below and next steps.

Package contents (attachments):
- xr_sig_evidence_v2.zip -> contains: SOC2 excerpts (control mappings), SIG matrix with pointers to CAIQ items, attestation/deletion-cert template (deletion-cert-2026-template.pdf), and the readme;
- log-sample-manifest.csv -> anonymized 12-row sample (we included both 10- and 20-sample files inside zip as you asked);
- deletion-cert-template.pdf -> fillable template for customer-signed proof-of-delete.

Key notes:
- We replaced tenant_ids with hashed identifiers (SHA256) and included timestamps and delete-actor metadata. No PII included.
- Our default retention policy for session/serving logs is 30 days for standard tenants; ephemeral workloads may be 7 days. We note this in the SIG mapping file.
- For auditability: the verification_status column indicates whether the deletion job completed and a post-delete scan verified zero records. For the samples provided, verification_status=true in 11/12 rows; the one failed row was due to a transient artifact and shows remediation steps.
- Legal-hold: we will create a short preservation snapshot and provide an escrow receipt if you need longer-term forensic custody; this is an add-on we can discuss.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the redaction approach is acceptable to your auditor.
2) If the auditor needs the mapping between hashed_id and original tenant_id, we can provide a signed, time-bound escrow to XRHealth Legal under an NDA and recorded request (we do not share mappings by default).
3) Let us know if you want the 20-sample manifest promoted as the primary deliverable.

We uploaded the ZIP to your Drive link and also sent a DocuSign envelope (link below) for the deletion-cert template if you want an executed attestation.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid-xr-signatures | DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/ZZY123456

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call to walk the auditor through the artifacts — available this afternoon (UTC) or tomorrow morning.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: xr_sig_evidence_v2.zip, log-sample-manifest.csv, deletion-cert-template.pdf
